execution.scope_decision: Owner authorized applying the System Design to the live ERP. Discovered a hard, deliberate constraint: css/main.css :root (the 20 D-001 tokens) is a cross-product brand contract that tests/mos-1-console pins verbatim — changing those token declarations (values OR wrapping in var()) breaks that drift test and ripples into another product.
